name: vrp_cg
brief:
Cut generator for VRP branch-and-cut

Implements specialized cut separation algorithms for capacitated VRP.

algorithms.name:
TSP Cuts:
  Subtour elimination for TSP subproblems:
algorithms.math:
tsp_cuts(): Find violated subtour elimination constraints
          x(E(S)) ≤ |S| - 1 for S ⊂ V
        Equivalent to connectivity: x(δ(S)) ≥ 2
ref:
Laporte, G. et al. (1985). "Optimal routing under capacity
       and distance restrictions". Operations Research 33(5).

Tarjan, R. (1972). "Depth-first search and linear graph
       algorithms". SIAM J. Computing 1(2):146-160.
